quarterly_data.signal: IES Holdings 8-K: on August 7, 2026 IES agreed to acquire DBM Global, a vertically integrated structural steel fabrication, erection and industrial services platform, from INNOVATE Corp. (first INNOVATE's approximately 91.2% interest, then the minority interests via a short-form merger); DBM Global, with brands including Schuff Steel, Banker Steel, GrayWolf, DBM Vircon and Aitken, over 2 million square feet of fabrication and operating facilities and approximately 3,400 employees, generated revenue of approximately $1.3 billion in the twelve months ended March 31, 2026 across commercial, industrial, data center, stadium and infrastructure end markets, and will become IES's new Structural line of business; closing was expected in the quarter ending December 31, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: DBM Global revenue approximately $1.3 billion (twelve months ended March 31, 2026)
